function GA(initial, evaluate):
    population = generate_random_population(initial)
    repeat N times:
        scores = evaluate_all(population)
        parents = select(population, scores)
        children = crossover(parents)
        mutated = mutation(children)
        population = mutated
    return best candidate in population

best = optimizer(best_GA , evaluate)

for each generation:
    population = selection + crossover + mutation
    for some individuals in population:

best_overall = None

for candidate in top_k_from_ga:
    improved = Tabu.run(candidate, evaluate)
    if best_overall is None or evaluate(improved) < evaluate(best_overall):
        best_overall = improved

return best_overall
